entries.subject: Donaldson thesis physical extents and nominal pole
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Section 3.3.2, printed page 79 physical extents; Table 3.1 supplies axis ratios a/b=1.6 and b/c=2.2. A smooth ellipsoid uses these proportions; no original convex mesh or local terrain is claimed.

entries.subject: SEPPCoN thermal radius as the display scale
entries.finding: The adopted thermal radius is 7.03 km. Using it as a volume-equivalent display radius is an explicit scaling convention; it does not measure a volume or absolute axis lengths.

entries.subject: Original light-curve inversion mesh
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: No public original mesh found in the thesis record or its conference abstract. The 162P paper makes the shape available on request. This package uses published numeric constraints only.
entries.revisitWhen: The author or an archive releases the original mesh with version, coordinate frame and reuse terms.

entries.subject: Inertia-equivalent ellipsoid
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: The 2023 paper reports inertia-equivalent axes. This scene consistently uses physical extents from the thesis, not a mix of both definitions.
entries.revisitWhen: New observations distinguish this alternative, or a comparison consistently uses its own axis definition and scale.
